metadata.description: agentPacks plugins generated for GitHub Copilot CLI.

plugins.name: delivery-loop
plugins.description: Uses the main agent to mediate planning, run plan-bound implementation and verification, fan reviewers out, and merge at most two fix rounds before an uncommitted hand-off.

plugins.name: dotnet
plugins.description: The C# and .NET pack: canonical build, implementation, test and review standards consumed by the delivery loop.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Blocks the git commands that destroy work an agent cannot get back: reset --hard, clean -fd, push --force, branch -D, and checkout or restore over the working tree.

plugins.name: pack-check
plugins.description: Detects the repository stack at session start and offers to install the language pack that supplies its required build and test skills.

plugins.name: rust
plugins.description: The Rust pack: canonical Cargo build, implementation, test and review standards consumed by the delivery loop.
